capabilities.name: music_recordings_search
capabilities.description: Search all recordings, including unpublished drafts. Returns exact IDs and revisions; use these before editing.

capabilities.name: music_recording_get
capabilities.description: Read one recording and its current revision.

capabilities.name: music_recording_save
capabilities.description: Create (id null) or patch existing recording (id from get/search). body is JSON using the existing editor schema; existing values are preserved. Never invent IDs, audio, lyrics or credits. Published/shared changes require approval. Use work melody/lyrics for BPM, key, genre, languages and credits; recording values are inferred.

capabilities.name: music_works_search
capabilities.description: Search all works, including unpublished drafts. Returns exact IDs and revisions; use these before editing.

capabilities.name: music_work_get
capabilities.description: Read one work and its current revision.

capabilities.name: music_work_save
capabilities.description: Create (id null) or patch existing work (id from get/search). body is JSON using the existing editor schema; existing values are preserved. Never invent IDs, audio, lyrics or credits. Published/shared changes require approval. Use work melody/lyrics for BPM, key, genre, languages and credits; recording values are inferred.

capabilities.name: music_vocabulary_search
capabilities.description: Search all vocabulary, including unpublished drafts. Returns exact IDs and revisions; use these before editing.

capabilities.name: music_vocabulary_get
capabilities.description: Read one vocabulary and its current revision.

capabilities.name: music_vocabulary_save
capabilities.description: Create (id null) or patch existing vocabulary (id from get/search). body is JSON using the existing editor schema; existing values are preserved. Never invent IDs, audio, lyrics or credits. Published/shared changes require approval. Use work melody/lyrics for BPM, key, genre, languages and credits; recording values are inferred.

capabilities.name: music_collections_search
capabilities.description: Read collections and their recording IDs from the existing Music Archive catalog.

capabilities.name: music_collection_save
capabilities.description: Create a collection/playlist (id null, title required) or edit a collection, reorder recordingIds and assign an existing uploaded cover. Publication and existing collections require approval.

capabilities.name: music_duplicates
capabilities.description: Detect possible duplicate recording titles or stored audio assets; only reports candidates, never deletes.

capabilities.name: events_search
capabilities.description: Read production live-session music queue; booking events are in bookings_search and catalog_search.

capabilities.name: bookings_search
capabilities.description: Read booking requests, statuses and quotes.

capabilities.name: customers_search
capabilities.description: Search customer records; private credential fields are always redacted.

capabilities.name: enquiries_search
capabilities.description: Read enquiries.

capabilities.name: confirmed_bookings
capabilities.description: Read confirmed bookings.

capabilities.name: transactions_report
capabilities.description: Read payment records, not payment credentials.

capabilities.name: equipment_search
capabilities.description: Read equipment, stock, media and reusable 3D assets.

capabilities.name: catalog_search
capabilities.description: Read events and services in the website catalog.

capabilities.name: testimonials_search
capabilities.description: Read testimonials and their replies.

capabilities.name: media_search
capabilities.description: Read website media.

capabilities.name: live_archive_search
capabilities.description: Read recorded broadcasts.

capabilities.name: meetings_search
capabilities.description: Read meeting schedule.

capabilities.name: theme_read
capabilities.description: Read seasonal theme configuration.

capabilities.name: ai_configuration_read
capabilities.description: Read AI configuration, model catalog and configured flags. Never exposes API keys.

capabilities.name: application_report
capabilities.description: Read application operational totals.

capabilities.name: equipment_update
capabilities.description: Update existing equipment through its validated editor. Pricing, stock and visibility require approval.

capabilities.name: testimonial_update
capabilities.description: Edit a testimonial or approve its public reply/publication. Does not send email.

capabilities.name: media_update
capabilities.description: Edit website media visibility, labels and existing media URLs.

capabilities.name: booking_note
capabilities.description: Update internal booking note only; no customer message or booking confirmation.

capabilities.name: equipment_create
capabilities.description: Create equipment with an explicit slug, name and category using the existing stock/pricing/model service. Requires approval.

capabilities.name: testimonial_create
capabilities.description: Create a testimonial using administrator-supplied text. Never invent a customer review; publication requires approval.

capabilities.name: media_create
capabilities.description: Create a media entry referencing an existing uploaded asset or supplied supported link. Requires approval.

capabilities.name: customer_create
capabilities.description: Create a normal customer record; no password, session or administrator privilege may be supplied. Requires approval.

capabilities.name: customer_update
capabilities.description: Update customer contact details or internal notes with approval. Never changes credentials or privileges.

capabilities.name: prices_read
capabilities.description: Read current service prices and linked equipment stock.

capabilities.name: price_update
capabilities.description: Patch an existing service price in cents, three-letter currency or availability. Always requires explicit approval.

capabilities.name: booking_quote_proposal
capabilities.description: Prepare a quotation proposal from real booking line items and explicit unit prices using the shared quote total calculation. Does not publish, email, confirm or reserve. Proposal is stored with the task.

capabilities.name: event_draft_read
capabilities.description: Read the initiating administrator account event/simulation draft. Never reads another customer draft.

capabilities.name: venues_search
capabilities.description: Read venue reports owned by the initiating administrator.

capabilities.name: player_playlist_read
capabilities.description: Read the homepage player playlist and order.

capabilities.name: theme_update
capabilities.description: Patch seasonal theme settings with current revision and approval. Audio must reference published recordings.

capabilities.name: player_playlist_update
capabilities.description: Set homepage player recordings, order and enabled state. Requires existing uploaded audio and approval.

capabilities.name: event_draft_save
capabilities.description: Patch this administrator account event plan. Does not submit a booking or affect another customer. Updates use exact shared field paths and values; existing fields are preserved.

capabilities.name: simulation_draft_read
capabilities.description: Read the initiating administrator account saved 3D room, equipment selection and positions.

capabilities.name: simulation_draft_save
capabilities.description: Create or patch this administrator account saved 3D simulation layout. Dimensions are conceptual unless a source note says otherwise. References existing equipment and reusable models; does not book stock.

capabilities.name: catalog_save
capabilities.description: Create (create true) or patch an event/service catalog option. Supply explicit slug id, kind and body. Service category must exist. Requires approval because it changes public booking choices.

capabilities.name: booking_planning_update
capabilities.description: Patch a confirmed booking event timeline, music plan and special requests. Preserves existing planning fields, does not email the customer. Requires approval.

capabilities.name: venue_dimensions_update
capabilities.description: Update an existing administrator-owned venue room dimensions or polygon with a source note. Never claims AI-estimated measurements are verified. Human approval required.

capabilities.name: music_classification_proposal
capabilities.description: Return a classification proposal and supporting rationale for human review; does not alter metadata.
